item.title: Bentonville Daily — August 9, 2026
item.description:
Upcoming public meetings and notable government actions in Bentonville on August 8, 2026.
Upcoming public meetings. City of Bentonville meetings and boards: Finance Committee (Aug 11), Combined Committee of the Whole and City Council (Aug 11), Board of Adjustments (Aug 12), Utility Board (Aug 18), Planning Commission (Aug 18), Tree and Landscape Committee (Aug 20), Public Art Advisory Board (Aug 20), and Finance Committee (Aug 25); agendas are posted for some meetings.
Heat advisory. NWS issued a Heat Advisory for Benton County with heat index values up to 108°F from noon to 8 PM CDT on August 9.
Northwest Arkansas growth. Local business owners report rapid regional growth bringing benefits and challenges.
Burn ban and wildfire risk. Two River Valley counties are under a burn ban during moderate wildfire risk amid hot and dry conditions.
Cooling center locations confirmed. Fayetteville confirmed cooling center locations for August 8 through 16 following resident feedback on access gaps.
Rogers school district Cyclospora precautions. Rogers School District is taking precautions as Benton County faces high cyclospora case numbers.
